# third-party/ — every outside file this project uses, with its licence

Nothing here was written by this project. Each file's origin, fetch time, SHA-256 and licence is one row of `SOURCES.tsv`. Model weights are not stored here; their licences are recorded in `../CITATIONS.md` from their Hugging Face model cards (`license: apache-2.0` for SmolLM2 and Pythia, read 2026-10-15).

If you add a file, add its row. If you cannot name its licence, do not add the file.
